scope: Survey-grounded AI4AI catalog organized as Benchmarks, Harness Design, and Model Design.
overlap_policy: A paper may appear in multiple public collections but only once within each collection.
citation_policy: For papers indexed as multiple versions, retain the largest title-verified count reported by the configured sources.
year_grouping: All yearly rankings use first public appearance year; a later venue year never moves a paper into a newer cohort.

research_refresh.note: Screened 1,748 distinct recent cs.AI/cs.CL titles, including overlap with the previous pass and 33 previously documented exclusions. Verified 194 candidate arXiv primary pages and explicit v1 histories: 166 in-scope additions and 28 exclusions. Research expands all three public collections. Checked 13 full papers for author-linked artifacts, adding SwarmEvolve code and correcting a punctuation-damaged Harness-S code link. Reassessed all ten existing news picks and checked current official model/research pages. Research is a bounded search, not a completeness claim for all disciplines. Nine primary-page follow-ups resolve as four historical additions (Auditing Harness Tampering, SEIS, MIRAI, PlanBench) and five duplicates; their dates use v1 rather than venue/latest revision. The official MIRAI project page additionally resolves its code repository.

metrics_refresh.note: Title-verified OpenAlex DOI batches and independent title searches on uncovered records; checked matching titles and retained max(existing, observed). Semantic Scholar probe returned HTTP 429. OpenAlex shared unauthenticated daily budget was exhausted during title fallback; unresolved known counts are retained and unknown counts remain null. Neither optional scholarly API key was configured. Authenticated GitHub REST refreshed every accessible configured repository. Picrew/LLM-Harness, a source-only record, returned authenticated HTTP 404 repeatedly; its prior code/star value is retained, so the full stars snapshot date is not advanced. A new paper-reported upwork/Payworthy repository also returns authenticated 404 and is not assigned invented code/stars. Full-paper checks added official SwarmEvolve code and repaired Harness-S URL punctuation. The complete-snapshot dates remain unchanged because coverage is partial; checked_on records this run.
